oracle: Python fractions.Fraction on original published weight strings, literal reference AF strings, FASTA orientation, and retained public VCF GTs. No pack, extracted genotype table, or engine contribution used as arithmetic input.
aggregate_tolerance: Absolute or relative 1e-12 for floating-point summary statistics and displayed percentiles; exact equality for scores and contributions.
scope: Four full published inventories, conditional common-callable autosomal baselines. Real genotype masking and score reconstruction only; no phenotype prediction, clinical calibration, ancestry normalization, or imputation-accuracy claim.

preparation.sample_selection: 128 evenly spaced original VCF header indices floor(i*(n-1)/127); every fourth selected sample is a target, other 96 are reference
preparation.scope: All four model inventories retained. Evaluation is conditional on common-callable terms; no phenotype or predictive accuracy assessment.
preparation.coverage_mask: Keep sites with MAF >= 0.05 in 96 disjoint reference samples. Approximation of common-variant coverage, not a commercial array manifest.
preparation.regional_mask: Controlled contiguous dropout of GRCh38 chr9:21,500,000-22,500,000 (zero-based half-open), not an empirical sequencing failure map.

notes: Available-data baseline: one frozen common-callable autosomal term set across baseline targets and all selected reference samples. Excluded terms remain counted; a subset is never a complete published PGS.
Experimental omissions contribute zero. Optional population-frequency fills are hypothetical reconstructions, including below production coverage gates; they never change production scoring rules.
Percentiles are numerical sensitivity diagnostics against frozen baseline distributions. A perturbed incomplete score is not a calibrated population percentile or a risk estimate.
Within-cohort reranking is reported separately. A constant or fewer-than-two reference distribution has no reported percentile. Cutoffs are descriptive, not clinical.
Per-term and regional deltas explain raw-score movement, not additive percentile changes. Overlapping regions must not be summed.
Frequency-source independence is declared by the user, not established by the software. Evaluation genotypes must not contribute to frequency estimation.
